thread:
maria: Quick thread — proposing an eviction-priority rewrite for the dedicated GPU orchestrator. Current immediate-preempt model is causing too much cold-start churn for queued tenants.
kevin: can you summarize the pain in 1 line? metrics or incidents?
maria: two recent incidents: spike -> many low-prio tenants killed -> pack/unpack thrash -> 2x latency for warmups, customers hit SLOs.
anuj: yep saw that in traces. also rack-level packing means killing one tenant can impact many others due to MIG fragmentation.
sophia: idea? soften preemption?
maria: propose: add a "soft-preempt" phase where we mark leases as evictable but wait Xs for voluntary drain, then hard-preempt only if headroom still negative. coupled with a per-tenant preempt-budget (tokens) to stop repeated kills.
raj: sounds promising. how do tokens replenish? time-based or credit-based on usage?
maria: replenish per hour based on SLA tier + recent preemption count. simple PoC rule: token += 1 per 10m, max 6.
kevin: API surface: do we need new fields on Lease proto? e.g.
```proto
message Lease {
  string tenant_id = 1;
  enum EvictState { ACTIVE=0; SOFT=1; HARD=2 }
  EvictState evict_state = 10;
  int32 preempt_tokens = 11;
}
```
leo: minor: prefer separate PreemptMetadata proto so proto churn is smaller.
anuj: operator vs control-plane question: who enforces tokens? operator (node-local) gives faster reaction, control plane owns quotas.
sophia: hybrid: operator enforces soft-preempt timers and local backoffs, control plane reconciles budgets and global accounting.
raj: what about fairness? low-tier tenants could always get soft-preempted and starve.
maria: fairness: introduce decay-weighted score: score = base_priority + alpha * recent_successful_runs - beta * preempt_count. soft-preempt order by lowest score.
kevin: cost/regret: soft-preempt increases memory of hot cache and may delay reclaim. need SLOs per burst window.
autoscaler-bot: note: autoscaler metrics will need new labels: evict_state and preempt_tokens. Will break some dashboards.
maria: plan: (1) implement operator-side soft-preempt timer + eviction marker (no hard kill) (2) add control-plane budget reconciliation endpoint (3) rollon dashboards and alerting (4) canary on one shard.
leo: rollout checklist: feature-flag operator, schema version for Lease metadata, dashboard patch, canary shard, kill-switch.
sophia: test ideas: chaos test: spike + cluster fill, measure churn and warmup latency. also validate token refilling doesn't starve production.
kevin: OK. who wants to own the PoC?
maria: I can start operator PoC this week. will mock control-plane budget as API returning tokens.
raj: I'll take dashboard + alert changes.
anuj: I'll add chaos harness and load tests.
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: maria/poc-soft-preempt -> staging at 2024-09-12T18:00:00Z :rocket:
kevin: LGTM as long as we keep kill-switch and canary limits.
maria: thanks all — will post RFC follow-up with proto sketches and operator flow by EOD.
